subject: Wide editorial still life photograph for a landscape banner: a clear glass cup of dark amber black tea on a pale linen tablecloth, standing in the left third of the frame, a curl of dried orange peel and two whole cloves beside the cup, a thin wisp of steam, soft low morning side light from the left, long gentle shadows reaching right. The right half of the frame is calm and uncluttered: only softly lit tablecloth and a plain warm wall, no objects, no plants, no window frame on the right, slightly high camera angle
